Vestia

Rules-based investing discipline for long-term investors. Set your allocation targets, import your broker's statement each month, and let Vestia keep you to your own rules.

What’s coming

🎯Allocation targetsDefine how your portfolio should be split, and see where it has drifted.
📥Broker CSV importUpload your broker's export each month instead of typing trades by hand.
🧭Discipline modeScheduled reviews on your own cadence, with a suggested monthly contribution based on your profile.
📈Holding chartsPrice history with your average-cost line, and each position's value over time.
👀WatchlistSearch tickers and follow them with compact trend charts.
💱Multi-currencyBuys, sells, dividends, fees and splits in any currency, converted with ECB reference rates.
🌗Light & darkFollows your system appearance, or pick one.
